test_launch_wait_for_one: test launch.launch waits for a single PyNode to terminate in test_multi_processing mode
test_launch_wait_for_all: test launch.launch waits for all nodes in a program to finish in test_multi_processing mode
test_launch_wait_for_some: test launch.launch waits only for specified node groups while leaving others running
test_launch_grouping: test launch.launch correctly groups process handles by named node groups
test_launch_program_stopper: test launch.launch with program_stopper to signal blocking nodes to terminate
